latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the Smart Context Engine for OpenClaw.
- Maintains conversation state and project continuity across sessions.
- Allows switching, tracking, and summarizing multiple projects.
- Supports manual and automatic saving/restoring of context.
- Includes commands for project management (save, switch, list, summarize).
- Integrates with long-term memory to keep project summaries.
